name: scope-cop
description: Claude stays inside the scope you set, and asks before leaving it. Edits outside it are flagged, or blocked if you want.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Turn Scope Cop on or off.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: What happens to an edit outside the scope. A: flag it. B: flag it and tell Claude. C: block it (Claude is told why).
